summary: Frontend-only verification of Inventory refactor (Kaeldor RPG). All 7 review scenarios PASSED end-to-end with mara@kaeldor.com/demo123. Sidebar has new 'Inventory' nav; /inventory renders all three panels (equipment, items, garage). Shop is confirmed buy-only. Vehicle Dealer is confirmed buy-only. Equip/unequip, consumable use, and vehicle buy→sell flows all work with correct data-testids and toasts.
critical_code_review_comments: Inventory.jsx guard `if (!inventory || !vehicles) return <Spinner />;` ignores `equipment` — if /equipment fails the page still renders but the Equipment panel shows no slots. Minor: on error catch, equipment is set to null so `equipment?.slots || []` maps to empty and the panel body is empty. Consider showing an inline error/empty state.

Sell handler in Inventory.jsx reads `r.res.data.value` — depends on the shape act() returns; ensure GameContext.act() consistently returns `{ok, res}`. Not observed failing but worth verifying to avoid a silent runtime error if the shape changes.

Shop and VehicleDealer both fetch on mount only; after purchase they rely on act() to refresh player state but not the listing — currently fine since listings are static, but if listings become dynamic (stock/availability) a refresh call is needed.
seed_data_creation: None — test bought 1 Energy Drink (consumed via Use), equipped/unequipped Nice Outfit, bought+sold a vehicle. Net inventory state effectively restored.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Inventory refactor verified. On login, mara currently has Business Suit equipped in outfit slot (equipped during this test then left equipped is possible — actually final state: outfit slot has Nice Outfit unequipped, and Business Suit was auto-equipped earlier per event log). If subsequent tests need a clean state, unequip via /inventory. No pending vehicles.
